propositions: Prevent ticket close when plan or pinned upstream plan changed during execution without running plan review inside close or invalidating implementation

Implement close_plan_review_gate_check that verifies signature and computes validity with CLOSE profile (excluding code freshness but keeping signature, registry, material, phase, and pin enforcement)
Add pre_status_check callback to txn.transition_core to run inside existing lock after structural checks but before STATUS append, enabling recheck between precheck and transaction commit
Default behavior with require_plan_review_for_close=false must be byte-for-byte equivalent with zero plan-review reads
Unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility must block close; pin drift blocks only when enforce_plan_material_pins=true
Fail-closed exceptions and non-network verdict delivery; force-close and exemptions (bugs, logs, reviews, identities) bypass both gates; structural child closure never bypassed
